injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 10 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Thunder.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Bucks.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 81 times in 100, by about 11; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
